messages.text: What are the most important signal integrity capabilities for applications in Wireless Communication?

The passages do not explicitly rank “most important” signal integrity capabilities for Wireless Communication; they support the following relevant capability areas across wireless/network infrastructure, high-speed digital SI/PI, and PCB/PCBA flows [1][22][23].
- High-speed interface validation using oscilloscopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices is a core SI-related capability for electrical interfaces [1][2].
- Transmission-channel validation across Tx/Rx packages, PCBs, connectors, and channel/test boards is a key SI capability for high-speed paths [1][2].
- RefClk and PLL jitter performance testing with phase noise analyzers and signal generators is explicitly listed as a validation block [1][2].
- Power Distribution Network testing with oscilloscopes and network analyzers is explicitly listed as a SI/PI validation block [1][2].
- ADC/DAC frontend performance testing with spectrum analyzers and signal generators is explicitly listed as a validation block [1][2].
- PCB/PCBA SI flow capabilities include insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and transmission-line calculation [1][2].
- PCB test-flow capabilities include material measurement with TDR impedance and Dk/Df extraction; material/stackup selection using IL, Dk/Df, roughness, impedance, crosstalk, TL modeling, and eye diagram; and SI modeling/testing using IL, Dk/Df, roughness, and impedance [4][33].
- For network infrastructure wireless applications, industry drivers include MIMO/beamforming, OTA, more spectrum bands, higher frequencies, expanding bandwidth, and Digital Design & Power [22].
- For Digital Design & Power in network infrastructure, the mapped instrument roles are VNA, probes, phase noise analyzer, power supplies, multimeter, oscilloscopes, and signal source [23].
【推論】For Wireless Communication applications, the most defensible SI capability set from the passages is channel/PCB characterization, timing-jitter validation, PDN validation, ADC/DAC frontend validation, and high-speed interface validation, because wireless network infrastructure lists Digital Design & Power as a driver and maps it to VNA/probes/phase-noise/oscilloscope/signal-source roles, while the SI/PI passages list those validation blocks and SI metrics [1][2][22][23].

5G NR SAN conformance testing › 測試對象與架構
依 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] slide 18，測試對象是 Satellite Access Node（DUT），transparent payload architecture。圖中文字包含：

- Gateway。
- NTN Payload RF。
- gNB。
- Feeder Link Emulator。
- Signal generator。
- Channel emulator for service link。
- Throughput measurement point。

來源 slide 6 說 [[3GPP]] Specification Work in Release 17 and Release 18 focuses on transparent bent-pipe payload architecture。SAN provides NR user plane and control plane protocol terminations towards NTN satellite-capable UE，connected via NG interface to 5GC，and encompasses a transparent NTN payload onboard a NTN platform、a gateway and gNB functions。

The passages do not explicitly rank “most important” signal integrity capabilities for Wireless Communication; they support the following relevant capability areas across wireless/network infrastructure, high-speed digital SI/PI, and PCB/PCBA flows [1][22][23].
- High-speed interface validation using oscilloscopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices is a core SI-related capability for electrical interfaces [1][2].
- Transmission-channel validation across Tx/Rx packages, PCBs, connectors, and channel/test boards is a key SI capability for high-speed paths [1][2].
- RefClk and PLL jitter performance testing with phase noise analyzers and signal generators is explicitly listed as a validation block [1][2].
- Power Distribution Network testing with oscilloscopes and network analyzers is explicitly listed as a SI/PI validation block [1][2].
- ADC/DAC frontend performance testing with spectrum analyzers and signal generators is explicitly listed as a validation block [1][2].
- PCB/PCBA SI flow capabilities include insertion loss, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and transmission-line calculation [1][2].
- PCB test-flow capabilities include material measurement with TDR impedance and Dk/Df extraction; material/stackup selection using IL, Dk/Df, roughness, impedance, crosstalk, TL modeling, and eye diagram; and SI modeling/testing using IL, Dk/Df, roughness, and impedance [4][33].
- For network infrastructure wireless applications, industry drivers include MIMO/beamforming, OTA, more spectrum bands, higher frequencies, expanding bandwidth, and Digital Design & Power [22].
- For Digital Design & Power in network infrastructure, the mapped instrument roles are VNA, probes, phase noise analyzer, power supplies, multimeter, oscilloscopes, and signal source [23].
【推論】For Wireless Communication applications, the most defensible SI capability set from the passages is channel/PCB characterization, timing-jitter validation, PDN validation, ADC/DAC frontend validation, and high-speed interface validation, because wireless network infrastructure lists Digital Design & Power as a driver and maps it to VNA/probes/phase-noise/oscilloscope/signal-source roles, while the SI/PI passages list those validation blocks and SI metrics [1][2][22][23].
